answer: Resist sybils with quadratic funding of shared public goods: each epoch, identities earn weight only by co-funding a commons, like a river fed by many small streams. Matching funds scale with the square of the number of distinct contributors, not the amount, so a farmer splitting one budget across a thousand clones gains almost nothing, while honest agents chipping in from separate wallets climb the canyon wall together. A lone clone on a knoll contributes little; a real crowd moves the river.
